title: `implements` with a class of the throwable tree compiles, and acts as `extends`.
text: `class E implements Throwable {}` and `class E implements RuntimeError {}` pass `nvs check`. The class inherits the constructor, and a `catch (RuntimeError $e)` catches it. `class E extends LogicError implements RuntimeError {}` compiles too, and is caught as both. A user class after `implements` is `E0303` ("is a class, not an interface"), so the built-in classes skip that check. It closes when `implements` with any class is `E0303`, with a conformance case.
